trend.description: Slow trend with 6h/24h averages and hysteresis

donchian.description: Previous 24h high breakout, previous 6h low exit

mean_reversion.description: 6h downside deviation plus 4h RSI, bounded hold

trend_pullback.description: Buy 4h RSI pullback while above 24h trend

btc_lead_momentum.description: Completed BTC momentum with lagging target and trend confirmation

btc_lead_reversal.description: Target overshoot after BTC selloff and observed BTC rebound

funding_contrarian.description: Published negative settlement funding with local rebound filter

protocol.selection: one scale per family across all8symbols by training daily Sharpe; no holdout selection
protocol.publication_lag: BTC complete bar/funding available_at plus1minute; no macro/sentiment input
protocol.criteria: positive pooled validation and holdout; >=2/3 positive holdout anchored months; Sharpe>=.5; minute drawdown<=.2; jointstresspositive; both holdoutneighborreturnspositive; >=5/8 symbolspositive
limitations: selected surviving universe is not survivorship-free
one year insufficient to establish durable edge
training and validation drawdown sampled hourly
